functionalities_tested: 1. Media-aware block hashing: same image + same position = same block hash (req 2,4,7 hit)
2. Media-aware block hashing: different image + same position = different block hash (req 3 miss)
3. Media-aware block hashing: same images + different positions = different block hash (req 8 miss vs req 6)
4. Encoder embedding cache: ViT skipped on repeated image bytes (req 2,4,5,6,7,8 hit)
5. Encoder embedding cache: ViT runs on new image bytes (req 1,3,9 miss)
6. Encoder embedding LRU: earlier images remain cached across multiple intervening requests (req 5 uses A after B)
7. Media boundary page trimming: multi-turn req 5 has image in prefix, trimming ensures correct suffix prefill
8. Multi-image content hashing: each image gets unique hash at its token positions (req 6,7,8)
9. Image order sensitivity: swapping image order produces different hashes (req 8 vs req 6)
10. Text-only backward compatibility: text requests use standard token hashing (req 10)
